streaming_bug.root_cause: ByteFallback turns a whole consecutive byte-token run into replacement characters if any byte is invalid; native DecodeStream had already emitted a valid prefix from that run.
streaming_bug.fix: Buffer consecutive byte-fallback runs until a non-byte token or EOF, matching full decode exactly.

telemetry.rates: Two-second rolling output TPS and whole-response average, first token excluded
telemetry.context: sequence_tokens is prompt plus generated output, not allocated/populated KV measurement
